newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY MIXED ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY MIXED ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted weaker on the U.S. dollar and the rand, but closed firmer against European currencies on Wednesday.
"There were quite a lot of buyers today. I hear someone out there was looking for U.S.$6 million and there were a number of smaller payments going out," one dealer commented.
The Zimbabwe dollar finished the day at 11.0250/0350 against the U.S. unit from 11.0100/0200 on Tuesday and was also quoted lower at 2.4960/5010 from 2.4800/5000 versus the rand.
It however edged up on the mark to 6.5500/5560 from 6.5900/6100 and was at 17.9660/9900 from 18.0400/0900 versus sterling.
